The *Dassanahetuttika* (Patthana 19.9) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Theravāda canon. It treats conditional relations structured around the triad (*tika*) pertaining to conditions eradicated by vision (*dassana*) and their associated roots (*hetu*) [DharmaNexus]. No dedicated translation or specific secondary literature discussions were identified in the dossier, in keeping with the highly formalized, repetitive analytical matrices of the later *Paṭṭhāna* books.

Computational text-reuse data from DharmaNexus records 37 matching passages between *Dassanahetuttika* and 16 other texts within the Pali canon, all situated in the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its primary textual alignments occur with other combinatorial sections involving the same doctrinal categories, such as *Dassanahetuttika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.33), *Parittattikādi* (Patthana 19.12), *Dassanattika* (Patthana 13.8), *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1), and *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 20.8) [DharmaNexus]. Further close alignments appear in *Hetuduka, Dassanahetuttika* (Patthana 21.24), *Sanidassanattika, Dassanahetuttika* (Patthana 23.47), *Kusalattika, Dassanahetuttika* (Patthana 23.8), and the root triad text *Dassanenapahātabbahetukattika* (Patthana 1.10) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan collections are reported at the evaluated threshold [DharmaNexus].
